title: The clock is running out for America’s most contentious spying law
description: Weeks before the end of the legislative session, some members of Congress are scrambling to reauthorize a controversial warrantless wiretapping authority, possibly by attaching it to a must-pass military spending bill. Sen. Mike Rounds (R-SD) told Politico that Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) could be attached to the National Defense Authorization […]
